purpose: Prove that the ordinary General Agent accepts general-purpose Revit work, selects a concrete execution lane, and reports completion truth without capability-subset refusals.

cases.prompt: Count all air devices in the project and break the total down by family and type. Use an existing air-device schedule if that is the best source.
cases.probe_prompt: Count all air devices in the project and break the total down by family and type. You may inspect an existing air-device schedule. Do not change the model.

cases.prompt: Change the selected piece of mechanical equipment's Mark to TEST-AHU-01 and verify the new value.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one mechanical-equipment instance whose Mark is writable, preview changing only that instance's Mark to TEST-AHU-01, and report the exact target and readback plan. Do not apply the change.

cases.prompt: Print sheet M000 to the selected printer using the current project print settings.
cases.probe_prompt: Preflight printing sheet M000 using the current Revit print setup. Resolve the exact sheet and printer, but do not send a physical print.

cases.prompt: Create a new coordination floor-plan view for Level 2 named M-LEVEL 2 COORDINATION.
cases.probe_prompt: Resolve Level 2 and preview creating a floor-plan view named M-LEVEL 2 COORDINATION. Do not create it.

cases.prompt: Duplicate the active plan with detailing and name the copy M-COORDINATION COPY.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one duplicable floor-plan view, then preview duplicating it with detailing as M-COORDINATION COPY. Do not create the copy.

cases.prompt: Duplicate sheet M000, including its placed views where Revit permits, and give the new sheet the next available temporary number.
cases.probe_prompt: Inspect sheet M000 and preview a composed duplication: a new sheet with the same title block and eligible duplicated placed views. Report any view that Revit cannot place twice. Do not create anything.

cases.prompt: Edit the selected equipment family, add a TEST-ONLY type with the requested dimensions, reload it, and apply that type only to the selected instance.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one editable loaded mechanical-equipment family instance and produce a read-only family-evolution plan for a TEST-ONLY type. Show the exact family, source type, parameters, reload, swap, and verification steps. Do not edit or reload the family.

cases.prompt: Find the mechanical-equipment instance with the lowest element ID whose Mark is writable, change only that instance's Mark to TEST-AHU-01, and verify the exact element and new value.
cases.probe_prompt: Find the mechanical-equipment instance with the lowest element ID whose Mark is writable and preview changing only that instance's Mark to TEST-AHU-01. Report the exact target and readback plan; do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Create a mechanical equipment schedule named TEST MECHANICAL EQUIPMENT with Mark, Family and Type, Level, and Comments fields.
cases.probe_prompt: Preview creating a mechanical-equipment schedule named TEST MECHANICAL EQUIPMENT with Mark, Family and Type, Level, and Comments. Do not create it.

cases.prompt: Add the Comments field to the selected schedule and place it after Mark.
cases.probe_prompt: Inspect one mechanical-equipment schedule and preview adding its Comments field after Mark. Do not change the schedule definition.

cases.prompt: Filter the selected mechanical equipment schedule so it shows only rows whose Mark begins with AHU.
cases.probe_prompt: Inspect a mechanical-equipment schedule with a Mark field and preview adding a begins-with AHU filter. Do not change the schedule.

cases.prompt: Sort the selected schedule by Level and then Family and Type, with a header for each level and no blank lines.
cases.probe_prompt: Inspect one schedule that has Level and Family and Type fields and preview sorting by Level then Family and Type, with level headers and no blank lines. Do not change it.

cases.prompt: In the equipment schedule, change the Comments value for the uniquely identified test row and verify the model instance agrees.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one itemized schedule row backed by a unique instance with a writable Comments parameter and preview changing only that cell to TEST-SCHEDULE-VALUE. Do not apply it.

cases.prompt: On the schedule named TEST MECHANICAL EQUIPMENT, add a filter so Mark begins with AHU and verify the saved schedule definition.
cases.probe_prompt: Inspect the schedule named TEST MECHANICAL EQUIPMENT and preview adding a begins-with AHU filter on Mark. Do not change the schedule.

cases.prompt: Hide Rooms in the active view and leave every other category setting unchanged.
cases.probe_prompt: Inspect the active view's visibility and preview hiding the Rooms category only. Do not change the view.

cases.prompt: In the active view, make existing ductwork halftone with thin gray projection lines without changing other categories.
cases.probe_prompt: Inspect the active view and preview a category override that makes Ducts halftone with thin gray projection lines. Preserve all unrelated overrides and do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Create a view filter for supply ducts and apply it to the active view with a red projection-line override.
cases.probe_prompt: Preview creating a parameter view filter for supply ducts and applying it to an eligible plan view with red projection lines. Resolve the exact category and rule parameter; do not change the model.

cases.prompt: Create a view template from the active plan named TEST HVAC COORDINATION TEMPLATE.
cases.probe_prompt: Inspect the active plan and preview creating a view template named TEST HVAC COORDINATION TEMPLATE from it. Do not create the template.

cases.prompt: Apply the TEST HVAC COORDINATION TEMPLATE to the selected coordination view.
cases.probe_prompt: Resolve an eligible non-template plan view and an available view template, then preview applying that template to the view. Do not change the view.

cases.prompt: Find the non-template FloorPlan view with the lowest element ID, create a view template named TEST HVAC COORDINATION TEMPLATE from it, apply the new template to that same source view, and verify the exact template assignment.
cases.probe_prompt: Find the non-template FloorPlan view with the lowest element ID and preview creating TEST HVAC COORDINATION TEMPLATE from it and applying the template back to that source view. Do not change the model.

cases.prompt: Replace the outdated selected note with the current issue wording without creating a duplicate.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one project TextNote, report its exact identity, and preview a conditional text replacement that would not create a duplicate. Do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Add the missing tag to the selected equipment and match the neighboring tag type and placement.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one taggable untagged visible equipment instance and preview adding a matching neighboring tag with clear geometry-aware placement. Do not create it.

cases.prompt: Add the missing device at the marked location and match the nearby family, type, level, host, and orientation.
cases.probe_prompt: Discover a compatible nearby device precedent and preview creating one matching family instance at a bounded test location. Resolve host, level, type, and orientation; do not create it.

cases.prompt: Remove the duplicated selected accessory after showing exactly what Revit will delete or disconnect.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one bounded candidate element and run a delete dry-run that reports exact cascade and connectivity impact. Do not delete anything.

cases.prompt: Move the selected device to the midpoint between its two neighboring devices while preserving host, level, and orientation.
cases.probe_prompt: Find a bounded three-instance alignment candidate and preview moving only the middle instance to the computed midpoint while preserving host, level, and orientation. Do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Rotate the selected annotation ninety degrees around its insertion point and verify its final orientation.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one rotatable annotation or family instance and preview a 90-degree rotation around its insertion point. Do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Change the selected device to match the compatible adjacent scheduled unit while preserving instance data and placement.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one instance with a compatible adjacent family/type precedent and preview changing only its type while preserving placement and writable instance data. Do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Reduce the selected duct after the takeoff and keep the system connected.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one bounded straight duct segment and preview a reversible size transition after a branch using observed compatible dimensions. Include connector and system verification; do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Step the selected pipe down after the branch and keep the network connected.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one bounded straight pipe segment and preview a reversible size transition using observed compatible diameters. Include connector and system verification; do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Connect the unconnected air terminal to the nearby compatible supply main and match the surrounding routing.
cases.probe_prompt: Find an unconnected air terminal and a compatible nearby supply main, then preview a bounded route with observed system, dimensions, level, fittings, and connector verification. Do not create it.

cases.prompt: Run the missing pipe connection from the selected branch to the selected fixture and match nearby standards.
cases.probe_prompt: Discover one feasible pair of compatible open pipe connectors and preview a bounded connection using observed system, type, size, level, and slope. Do not create it.

cases.prompt: Offset the selected duct around the obstruction and preserve both connected ends with the fewest practical fittings.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one bounded straight duct suitable for a reversible dogleg and preview an offset around a small test obstruction while preserving endpoint connections, system, and size. Do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Find the uniquely identifiable mechanical-equipment schedule row with a writable Supply Airflow value, change the backing model value to a compatible test value derived from its current units, verify that the schedule and model agree, and report the exact element.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one uniquely identifiable mechanical-equipment schedule row with a writable Supply Airflow value and preview changing its backing model value to a compatible test value derived from the current units. Show the exact row, element, old value, proposed value, and schedule/model readback plan. Do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Find one equipment tag whose displayed designation is driven by a writable tagged-element parameter, change that driving value to a unique test designation, and verify the tag and corresponding schedule/model value agree without editing tag graphics.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one equipment tag whose displayed designation is driven by a writable tagged-element parameter and produce a bounded preview for synchronizing it to a unique test designation. Identify the tag, tagged element, driving parameter, and verification sources. Do not change the model.

cases.prompt: In an eligible plan view, find visible mechanical-equipment instances whose Comments parameter is writable and currently blank, set only those matching instances to TEST-ISSUE, and verify all and only the matched IDs changed.
cases.probe_prompt: In an eligible plan view, evaluate the rule 'visible mechanical equipment with writable blank Comments', report the exact matching and non-matching IDs, and preview setting only the matches to TEST-ISSUE. Do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Find a bounded cluster of overlapping or crowded tags in an eligible view, improve their spacing without changing what they label, and verify the same tag targets remain with a better overlap score.
cases.probe_prompt: Find a bounded cluster of overlapping or crowded tags in an eligible view and preview moving only their heads to improve spacing. Preserve tag targets and leaders, report before/after geometry and the overlap metric, and do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Find one unambiguous connected MEP branch that can accept a compatible nearby accessory precedent, insert one matching test accessory on that branch, and verify type, connectors, and system continuity.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one unambiguous connected MEP branch and a compatible nearby accessory precedent, then preview inserting one matching accessory. Resolve exact type, branch, connectors, system, placement, and cleanup plan. Do not create it.

cases.prompt: Find one movable connected MEP accessory with a clear nearby relocation direction, move it by a bounded test offset while preserving its connections and system, and verify exact final location and connectivity.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one movable connected MEP accessory and preview a bounded relocation that keeps it connected and accessible. Report exact target, offset, connector constraints, system, before/after coordinates, and restoration plan. Do not apply it.

cases.prompt: Find one bounded connected MEP sub-run, trace its exact extent, and show the complete delete and disconnect impact without deleting anything.
cases.probe_prompt: Find one bounded connected MEP sub-run, trace its endpoints and connected extent, and run an exact delete/cascade dry-run. Report every affected or disconnected ID and do not mutate the model.

cases.prompt: Perform this valid Revit operation even if there is no dedicated Operator tool: inspect the relevant Revit API surface, execute the smallest bounded change, and verify it.
cases.probe_prompt: Demonstrate the fallback ladder for a valid Revit task with no assumed dedicated primitive: search the tool registry, then search the native API catalog, and describe a bounded preview/apply/readback plan. Do not mutate the model.
